offering_description.value: Designs, makes and markets personal care products, including shaving, sun care, feminine care and wet wipes, sold mainly to consumers through retail stores and online. It owns the brands and outsources part of its production.

primary_products.value: razors and shaving systems; sunscreen and after-sun products; feminine care products; wet wipes; skin care products

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers buying personal care products for shaving, sun protection and hygiene; B2B: mass merchants, drugstores, grocery chains and online retailers that resell its products

end_markets.value: personal care; sun care; feminine care; shaving; baby and household wipes

revenue_model.value: product sales: consumers and retailers pay for shaving, sun care, feminine care and wipes products

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets its brands, sold to retailers and distributors; OEM / manufacturer: makes products in its own plants and with contract manufacturers, sold to retailers

geography_served.value: global: sells in North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: shaving, sun care, feminine care and wet wipes lines that share retail customers and consumer marketing

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchants, drugstores, grocery and warehouse club chains; online: e-commerce retailers and the company's own online storefronts; distributors / dealers: wholesalers and distributors serving smaller retailers and international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: sunscreens regulated as over-the-counter drugs by the FDA, cosmetics and product safety rules apply
